title: DescribeResponse
description: Which language the toolchain serves, which files are its source and its tests, where its practices are, and which checks it has.

language.description: The language's name, such as TypeScript.

items.description: A pattern with * and **, relative to a checkout.

sourceFiles.description: Patterns of the files that are the language's source, tests included.

items.description: A pattern with * and **, relative to a checkout.

testFiles.description: Patterns of the files that are tests; test runs them.

practices.description: The path, relative to the kit, of the file that lists the language's practices.

checks.description: The names of the checks, in the order check runs them.

checkName.description: The name of one check, such as lint.
